summary.text: Andrés Romero, listed by Ballotpedia as G. Andres Romero, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 10 who took office on January 1, 2015, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Romero's professional experience includes working as a social studies teacher.

paragraphs.text: Romero earned a B.A. in history and philosophy from the University of New Mexico in 2010.

In the 2023-2024 session, Romero chaired the House Education Committee and also served on the Rules and Order of Business Committee and the Transportation, Public Works & Capital Improvements Committee.
